generator: Blender 4.2 Cycles (CPU, OIDN), numpy-groomed hair curves; see scratchpad/blender/sprites.py

body.notes: column k is pre-rotated to screen angle k/angles*PI (body axis (cos, sin), y down) and lit by the fixed screen light; rotate by the residual (<= half a bucket). Each cell is a window cut from a continuous rendered fur tube: |along| <= along*R*(1-(|across|/1.5R)^4)^0.25 with a +-feather*R smoothstep cross-fade, the sides keep the real silhouette fuzz (fuzz = reach beyond R). Stamp it every ~0.3R (dense 0.075R stamping only shows a thin rim slice of each cell and smears the fur into streaks). Straight alpha.

head.generator: Blender 4.2 Cycles (CPU, OIDN); head v2 measured from the client photo; scratchpad/blender/head-v2/atlas_head.py

eye.notes: head-local units of R (body radius), x forward, y down (sprite space, before rotation). Eye 0 is drawn when the screen-up side is local -y (cos th > 0), eye 1 when cos th < 0, both when |cos th| < two_eyes_below_abs_cos. Use for a pointer glint overlay; the beads + key-light glint are already baked.
moved_to: u: + = jaw side (opposite the eye side of the source cell)

neck_band.units: body widths (w = 2R) of arc length behind the head origin (head centre = path head point)
neck_band.photo: pink head fur -> cream -> black -> pink (no black edge on the head side); measured cream ~0.4-0.5 w visible, black ~0.12-0.18 w, next regular band's leading black ~1.4 R after the neck band
neck_band.notes: Not baked into head.webp. Engine: first band = cream at start_w (its front ~0.1 w hides under the head's back fur / fade), black right after it, then pink; regular black|cream|black bands resume at next_band_w. Equivalently uStart = uAt(start_w * w) with the first period starting at its cream (skip BAND[0]).

scale.notes: the head is 2*1.20 R wide (skin) / ~3.46 R incl. fur; draw the cell at R/ref_R with the origin on the path's head point (head centre). Equivalent: rh = head_scale * R, scale = rh / rh_ref.

head.notes: cell b at column b % cols, row floor(b / cols); head points +x, lit for heading th = b/buckets*2PI with the fixed screen key light (rotate the cell by th about origin). Neck fade baked into alpha (x in neck_fade_R). Eyes baked (see eye). No tongue (engine draws it; base at the snout tip, see tongue_base_R). Straight alpha.

cap.notes: furry ball of radius rc_ref px with body-scale fur (scale by rc/rc_ref).
